instruction: In django/db/backends/base/schema.py, in the block under the comment "# Find the index for this field", add these three lines right before the line "meta_index_names = {index.name for index in model._meta.indexes}": "meta_constraint_names = {", then, indented one level deeper, "constraint.name for constraint in model._meta.constraints", then "}". Then change the argument "exclude=meta_index_names," of the call below to "exclude=meta_constraint_names | meta_index_names,".
